probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Skip to content Dario Castelli Architect, Milan Close Projects About Journal Contact [email protected] LinkedIn Instagram Overview Show image 1 Show image 2 Corte Vigentina Housing, Milan, 2024 Notes Client Housing cooperative Type Housing Year 2024 Location Milan Area 3,600 m² Status Completed Casa Lario Biblioteca Olona Corte Vigentina Thirty-two flats for a housing cooperative, built around a courtyard on the site of a former tram depot in the south of Milan. Every flat has a deep loggia facing the courtyard, big enough for a table and six chairs. The loggias are the real living rooms for half the year, and the tall timber shutters let each family close theirs off when they want to. The brick is handmade in Lombardy and laid in a soft lime mortar, so the walls will weather the way the old courtyards around them have.
